message:
I remember the time we had a surprise snowstorm, and I had grand plans for a cozy day inside. I stocked up on hot cocoa and snacks, only to realize I had no firewood and the power went out! There I was, huddled under blankets with a candle, feeling like I was in some sort of winter survival reality show. 

After that, I learned to keep a little stash of firewood handy and check my supplies ahead of time—nothing fancy, just a simple reminder that sometimes, the best laid plans are the ones that involve a bit of prep. 

What’s your go-to tip for weathering the storm? ☕
